headlines.title: Shopify Stock Is Up 30% in Three Months & Numbers Point to 170% More Upside in the Long Run. Here’s Why.
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysShopify stock has gained 30% since June 30, driven by an August 5 earnings beat and a September 21 Meta deal. Analysts rate it 31 buys, 11 outperforms, 11 holds and 1 sell, and the $173 mean target sits 17% above the close, down from a 30% gap on June 30.

headlines.summary: Shopify's revenue growth rate outpaces Uber's, yet their absolute scale gap has held steady over eight quarters.

headlines.title: Is Shopify (SHOP)’s AI Opportunity Bigger Than it Looks?
headlines.summary: On September 23, Mizuho reiterated an Outperform rating and $180 price target on Shopify Inc. (NASDAQ:SHOP), viewing a recent stock pullback as a compelling buying opportunity. The weakness occurred after reports surfaced that Meta Platforms is planning a Meta Pay wallet for its new Muse AI assistant, causing investors to fear potential disintermediation.

headlines.title: Market America completes sale of SHOP.COM domain name, ushering in a new era for the global entrepreneurship company
headlines.summary: Market America Worldwide today announced the completion of the sale of the SHOP.COM domain name to Shopify, marking a significant milestone in the company's digital evolution and the beginning of a new chapter for the 34-year-old global business.

description: Shopify Inc., a commerce technology company, provides tools to start, scale, market, and run a business of various sizes in Canada, the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. The Company offers Shopify platform that enables merchants to manage products and inventory, process orders and payments, fulfill and ship orders, build customer relationships, source products, leverage analytics, and reporting and access financing for running their business across all of their sales channels, including web and mobile storefronts, physical retail locations, social media storefronts, and marketplaces. It also provides Shopify Payments, a fully integrated payment processing service that allows merchants to accept and process payment cards online and offline. In addition, the company engages in the sale of themes and apps; shipping labels through Shopify Shipping; point-of-sale hardware; advertising on the Shopify App Store; and Shop Campaigns for buyer acquisitions, as well as registration of domain names. The company was formerly known as Jaded Pixel Technologies Inc. and changed its name to Shopify Inc. in November 2011. Shopify Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Ottawa, Canada.
